verdict_rationale: CSLB (California Contractors State License Board) is a California state government agency under the Department of Consumer Affairs. All contractor license records are mandatory public disclosures under California Government Code §6250 (California Public Records Act) and Business & Professions Code §7083. CSLB explicitly provides a bulk 'Master License Data' download at no cost and no login requirement at https://www.cslb.ca.gov/OnlineServices/DataPortal/. Fields: license number, business name, DBA, license class, entity type, mailing address, city, state, ZIP, county, phone, expiration/issue date — all standard regulatory public fields. No SSNs, DOB, financial accounts. The mailing address is the contractor's registered business address (required for state licensing). CSLB data is commercially resold by InfoUSA, DataAxle, Scrap.io, and similar vendors at $0.10-$2.00/record. This is unambiguously public data with a clear commercial resale precedent. PASS.

pii_check.notes: Mailing address is the contractor's registered business address on their state license, per CSLB requirements. Sole proprietors use their business address. This is regulatory public disclosure — same legal basis as FAA aircraft registration and NPPES NPI records.
